evidence.title: atai Life Sciences and Beckley Psytech Announce Positive Topline Results from the Phase 2b Study of BPL-003 in Patients with Treatment-Resistant Depression
AtaiBeckley Announces Positive Topline Data from the Phase 2b Open-Label Extension Study of BPL-003, Supporting Safety and Efficacy of a Second Dose in Patients with Treatment-Resistant Depression
BPL-003: Positive Phase 2b Open-Label Extension Study Data

outcomes.note: On 2025-09-23 the sponsor reported the Phase 2a two-dose induction regimen (NCT05660642, 8 mg then 12 mg two weeks later, n=13 enrolled, 12 per protocol): mean MADRS reduction from baseline 13.3 points at day 2, 12.9 at day 8, 19.0 one week after the second dose, and 13.7 at week 12. The corresponding single active dose in the Phase 2b (2025-07-01) gave 12.1 points for 8 mg and 11.1 for 12 mg at the day 29 primary timepoint. The two-dose point estimate, 19.0, is larger, and the week 12 estimate, 13.7, is also larger. The 2025-11-10 Phase 2b open-label extension confirms the direction: 22.3 points at day 57 for patients whose first dose was 8 mg. The criterion asks only for a larger point estimate, not a significant difference.

BPL-003 Phase 3 Program Initiation on Track for Q2 2026 Following Successful FDA End-of-Phase 2 Meeting; AtaiBeckley Highlights Key Pipeline Milestones at 2026 Investor Day

outcomes.note: No FDA approval of BPL-003 exists at checked_through: Drugs@FDA holds no application for mebufotenin or BPL-003. The programme is still pre-submission. After a successful End-of-Phase 2 meeting (2026-03-03), the sponsor started two parallel Phase 3 trials, ReConnection-1 and ReConnection-2, in Q2 2026 and guides both topline readouts to early 2029. Two pivotal trials, not one, are now running, which bears on the single-trial reading, but the criterion reads the number of Phase 3 efficacy trials from the approval documents, and no such documents exist yet. Breakthrough Therapy designation (October 2025) is a designation, not an approval. This states nothing about later dates.

evidence.title: AtaiBeckley Announces Positive Topline Data from the Phase 2b Open-Label Extension Study of BPL-003, Supporting Safety and Efficacy of a Second Dose in Patients with Treatment-Resistant Depression
AtaiBeckley Announces Positive Topline Data from the Phase 2b Open-Label Extension Study of BPL-003 (full release text)
BPL-003: Positive Phase 2b Open-Label Extension Study Data

outcomes.note: On 2025-11-10 the sponsor reported topline data from the open-label extension of the BPL-003 Phase 2b programme in TRD (NCT05870540), with quantitative outcomes: mean MADRS reduction from baseline at day 57 of 14.0 points for the 0.3 mg initial-dose group (n=47), 22.3 points for the 8 mg initial-dose group (n=23) and 19.0 points for the pooled active group (n=60), plus 63 percent response and 48 percent remission at week 8. That meets the quantitative-outcome bar. The date follows the asset, which names the Phase 2b programme. Under a wider reading of open-label BPL-003 data of any study, the earlier Phase 2a two-dose induction release of 2025-09-23 would also qualify.
